Name: Faster Uppergrade Machines
Author: cikicool331
Description:
Adds speed support for Upper-grade's Double Keg and Long Preserves Jar.

By default, this mod mirrors your Faster Kegs and Preserves Jars config:
[list]
[*]Double Keg uses your Keg multiplier and keep-quality setting.[/*]
[*]Long Preserves Jar uses your Jar multiplier and keep-quality setting.[/*]
[/list]
It also includes optional config support for Upper-grade's Long Cask and Double Furnace.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Upper-grade.[/*]
[*]Optional: install Faster Kegs and Preserves Jars if you want this mod to mirror that config.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0+.
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional; without it, edit config.json manually.
